name: La Byle, Seeker of the Winds
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
Whenever this creature blocks, untap it after it battles.
flavorText: "Breeze? Nah. Gust? Nah. Tornado? Aw, yeah."

name: King Mazelan
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may choose a creature in the battle zone and return it to its owner's hand.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: It patrols the Cyber Lords' new undersea city. In exchange, it gets to eat any intruders it finds.

name: Sinister General Damudo
rulesText: When this creature is destroyed, destroy all creatures that have power 3000 or less.
flavorText: "The Fiona Woods will sustain us only for so long. We must push deeper into the Nature realm."

name: Bladerush Skyterror Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: Its war cry shreds the clouds. Its blades shred everything else.

name: Obsidian Scarab
rulesText:
Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power.)
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
When this creature is destroyed, you may put an Obsidian Scarab from your mana zone into the battle zone.

name: Ballus, Dogfight Enforcer Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : At the end of each of your turns, untap this creature.
flavorText: To indicate the telepathic link shared by all Survivors, scientists added a code letter to their names.

name: Calgo, Vizier of Rainclouds
rulesText: This creature can't be blocked by creatures that have power 4000 or more.
flavorText: "Arise, Vizier of Rainclouds. Your lash is the blade of justice." —Hanusa, Radiance Elemental

name: Gallia Zohl, Iron Guardian Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
flavorText: My true home is not in the Light realm. It is with the Survivors.

name: Glory Snow
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
If your opponent has more cards in his mana zone than you have in yours, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your mana zone.

name: Kulus, Soulshine Enforcer
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, if your opponent has more cards in his mana zone than you have in yours, put the top card of your deck into your mana zone.
flavorText: Right-side up, it's solar powered. Upside down, it's lunar powered!

name: La Guile, Seeker of Skyfire
rulesText: Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: Today's weather report: partly cloudy, with an 80 percent chance of being blasted from space.

name: Le Quist, the Oracle
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may choose a darkness or fire creature in the battle zone and tap it. (First choose what this creature is attacking. Then choose a creature to tap.)
flavorText: "I have developed a devastating new weapon to combat the forces of chaos. I call it ?nap time.'"

name: Snork La, Shrine Guardian
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack players.
Whenever your opponent causes a card to be put into your graveyard from your mana zone, you may return that card to your mana zone.

name: Syforce, Aurora Elemental
rulesText:
Blocker (When an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may return a spell from your mana zone to your hand.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)

name: Thunder Net
rulesText: For each water creature you have in the battle zone, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and tap it.
flavorText: "When the device is activated, a net of electricity snares our enemies!" —Syrius, Firmament Elemental

name: Aqua Surfer
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may choose a creature in the battle zone and return it to its owner's hand.
flavorText: "Wave goodbye!"

name: Divine Riptide
rulesText: Each player returns all cards from his mana zone to his hand.
flavorText: "The Megapocalypse has arrived. It's a bit early, huh?" —Pokolul

name: Lurking Eel
rulesText: Fire and nature blocker (Whenever an opponent's fire or nature creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
flavorText: The safest place can conceal the greatest danger.

name: Miracle Quest
rulesText: Whenever any of your creatures finishes attacking this turn, you may draw 2 cards for each shield it broke.
flavorText: "Search high and low! We must find the jade idol! And while you're at it, see if you can find my car keys." —Tropico

name: Pokolul
rulesText: Whenever your opponent uses the "shield trigger" ability of a shield broken by this creature, you may untap this creature.
flavorText: The cosmic offspring of Father Time and a motherboard.

name: Sea Slug
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't be blocked.
flavorText: The Cyber Lords have high standards of beauty for their creations. They have even higher standards of ugliness.

name: Solidskin Fish
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, return a card from your mana zone to your hand.
flavorText: If you look closely enough, you'll notice the rock has eyes. And teeth.

name: Spikestrike Ichthys Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : This creature can't be blocked.
flavorText: "If the Megapocalypse couldn't stop me, what makes you think you can?"

name: Split-Head Hydroturtle Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : Whenever this creature attacks, you may draw a card.
flavorText: "No fair! The more Survivors there are, the stronger they become!" —Mini Titan Gett

name: Steel-Turret Cluster
rulesText: This creature can't be attacked by fire or nature creatures.
flavorText: After an analysis of its armor was performed, a squad of decoy troops was quickly constructed.

name: Gigakail
rulesText: Nature and light slayer (Whenever this creature battles a nature or light creature, destroy the nature or light creature after the battle.)
flavorText: What it was built out of isn't nearly as disturbing as what was done with the leftovers.

name: Gigaling Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : Slayer (Whenever this creature battles, destroy the other creature after the battle.)
flavorText: Did the Megapocalypse create the Survivors, or did it just set them free?

name: Gigazoul
rulesText: While your opponent has no shields, this creature can't attack.
flavorText: "Perhaps I went a little too far with the experiment...." —Ballom, Master of Death

name: Horned Mutant
rulesText: Each nature creature costs 1 more to summon, and each nature spell costs 1 more to cast.
flavorText: After pulling out its own horns to use as weapons, it can grow a new pair in less than a day.

name: Jewel Spider
rulesText: When this creature is destroyed, you may choose one of your shields and put it into your hand. You can't use the "shield trigger" ability of that shield.
flavorText: It climbs webs, walls, trees-anything and everything-in search of warm blood.

name: Scheming Hands
rulesText: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card from it. Your opponent discards that card.
flavorText: "Everyone has secrets. Everyone but you." —Trox, General of Destruction

name: Skullsweeper Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : Whenever this creature attacks, your opponent chooses and discards a card from his hand.
flavorText: They don't like it when their victims twitch. They're ticklish.

name: Slime Veil
rulesText: During your opponent's next turn, each of his creatures attacks if able.
flavorText: "Hey, you're really getting the hang of that. Now make him do a little dance." —Dark Titan Maginn

name: Vashuna, Sword Dancer
rulesText:
While your opponent has no shields, this creature can't attack.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "Now, you shall see the ancient secrets of the East!"

name: Wisp Howler, Shadow of Tears
rulesText: Nature and light slayer (Whenever this creature battles a nature or light creature, destroy the nature or light creature after the battle.)
flavorText: Although it has no body to feed, it never stops devouring souls.

name: Blazosaur Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : Power attacker +1000 (While attacking, this creature gets +1000 power.)
flavorText: The Blazosaur's roar echoes in the ears of every Survivor.

name: Bolgash Dragon
rulesText:
Power attacker +8000 (While attacking, this creature gets +8000 power.)
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields.)
flavorText: Its suit of armor belches out an electric smog cloud that serves as both camouflage and weapon.

name: Bombat, General of Speed
rulesText: Speed attacker (This creature doesn't get summoning sickness.)
flavorText: "Too slow! Do I have to sit on a rocket to go faster?!"

name: Cannoneer Bargon
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
This creature can't attack players.
flavorText: "Why bother aiming? I just fire in all directions at once."

name: Cataclysmic Eruption
rulesText: For each nature creature you have in the battle zone, you may choose a card in your opponent's mana zone and put it into his graveyard.
flavorText: The skies fell, the seas boiled, the caves collapsed, the volcanoes melted, and the forests burned. The planet cracked open, and the Megapocalypse began.

name: Cyclone Panic
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Each player counts the cards in his hand, shuffles these cards into his deck, then draws that many cards.

name: Kip Chippotto
rulesText: When one of your Armored Dragons would be destroyed, you may destroy this creature instead.
flavorText: Only the Dragons realize these cute little birds hold the secrets of immortality.

name: Rikabu, the Dismantler
rulesText: Speed attacker (This creature doesn't get summoning sickness.)
flavorText: "I'll have that ripped apart in no time!"

name: Ruthless Skyterror
rulesText:
This creature can attack untapped water creatures.
This creature can't attack players.
flavorText: "If you don't kneel before my wrath, you'll certainly kneel after it."

name: Twin-Cannon Skyterror
rulesText:
Speed attacker (This creature doesn't get summoning sickness.)
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: The first cannon blasts your flesh. The second cannon blasts your soul.

name: Ambush Scorpion
rulesText:
Power attacker +3000 (While attacking, this creature gets +3000 power.)
When this creature is destroyed, you may choose an Ambush Scorpion in your mana zone and put it into the battle zone.
flavorText: Its hard outer shell covers up an even harder inner core.

name: Balloonshroom Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : When this creature would be destroyed, put it into your mana zone instead.
flavorText: During the Megapocalypse, the only way to survive was to cooperate...and adapt.

name: Bloodwing Mantis
rulesText:
Whenever this creature attacks, return 2 creatures from your mana zone to your hand.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: From the moment it's born to the moment it dies, its wings never stop moving.

name: Brutal Charge
rulesText: At the end of this turn, search your deck. For each of your opponent's shields your creatures broke this turn, you may take a creature from your deck, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
flavorText: Kondu started to regret joining Wrugh's carpool.

name: Crow Winger
rulesText: This creature gets +1000 power for each water creature and darkness creature your opponent has in the battle zone.
flavorText: The Dark Lords' presence in the Fiona Woods warped more than just the trees.

name: Enchanted Soil
rulesText: Put up to 2 creatures from your graveyard into your mana zone.
flavorText: "Souls don't truly depart this world. They merely rest for a time." —Fighter Dual Fang

name: Moon Horn
rulesText:
This creature gets +1000 power for each water creature and darkness creature your opponent has in the battle zone.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "Sometimes he'll go hog wild at a party and totally pig out. But he's usually such a boar." —Fear Fang

name: Nocturnal Giant
rulesText:
This creature can't attack creatures.
Power attacker +7000 (While attacking, this creature gets +7000 power.)
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields.)
flavorText: Does it harness the power of the stars? Does it prefer the cover of night? Or does it just get sunburned really easily?

name: Scissor Scarab
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, search your deck. You may take a Giant Insect from your deck, show that Giant Insect to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.

name: Smash Horn Q
rulesText: Survivor (Each of your Survivors has this creature's Survivor ability.) : This creature gets +1000 power.
flavorText: The symbol on its back is proof of its refusal to die.

name: Syrius, Firmament Elemental
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields.)
flavorText: "The Megapocalypse is over. But the damage has just begun."

name: King Tsunami
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, return all other creatures from the battle zone to their owners' hands.
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields.)
flavorText: The last time it did a backflip, the resulting tidal waves sank three islands.

name: Death Cruzer, the Annihilator
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy all your other creatures.
Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields.)
flavorText: Its only friend is the empty echo of death.

name: Billion-Degree Dragon
rulesText: Triple breaker (This creature breaks 3 shields.)
flavorText: The Megapocalypse woke it from its slumber deep within the molten core of the planet. It is the avenger of the world. It is legendary. And it is very, very cranky.

name: Avalanche Giant
rulesText:
This creature can't attack creatures.
Whenever this creature becomes blocked, it breaks one of your opponent's shields.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: Its name is misleading. Mountains tremble in fear at the sight of it, and that causes avalanches. What it actually does to the mountains is much, much worse.
